username.title: User
username.description: Username to use to access the SFTP server.

destination_path.title: Destination path
destination_path.description: Path to the directory where CSV files will be written.

extraction_mode.title: Extraction Mode
extraction_mode.description: Choose between streaming mode (direct) or pandas mode (full DataFrame export).

filename.title: CSV Filename
filename.description: Override the default CSV filename (default: {stream}.csv). File name WITHOUT extension.

add_timestamp_to_filename.title: Add Timestamp to Filename
add_timestamp_to_filename.description: Append the current UTC timestamp (Zulu time) to the CSV filename before the .csv extension.

separator.title: CSV Separator
separator.description: Character used to separate CSV fields.

encoding.title: CSV Encoding
encoding.description: File encoding to use when writing CSV files.

quoting.title: CSV Quoting
quoting.description: CSV quoting style: ALL, MINIMAL, NONNUMERIC, NONE

include_header.title: Include Header
include_header.description: Whether to write the header row in the CSV file.

line_terminator.title: Line Terminator
line_terminator.description: Character(s) to use as line terminator in CSV files. Default is LF (\n), put CRLF (\r\n) if needed.

batch_size.title: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Number of records to write in direct streaming mode.
